authallgls.title: Authorize Group to Change All GL Component Types
authallgls.remarks: Indicates whether this group can edit all GL segments

masissuer.title: MAS Issuer
masissuer.remarks: Issuer can be local MAS grou or IDP or SAML

independent.title: Independent of Other Groups
independent.remarks: Indicates whether the setting on this Group will apply to sites on other non-independent groups and vice-versa.

createddate.title: Created on
createddate.remarks: The date the user record was created.

passwordduration.title: Password Lasts this Number of Days
passwordduration.remarks: Number of days that a password is active. Defaults from the maxvar PASSWORDDURATION.

reportstoplimit.title: Report Server Records Limit
reportstoplimit.remarks: The maximum number of records in the report hierarchy that are processed before the report is canceled on the report server. This limit prevents extremely large reports from running.

authallrepfacs.title: Authorize Group for All Repair Facilities
authallrepfacs.remarks: Specifies whether to allow the group access to all records that specify any repair facility.

authlaborself.title: Authorize Group for Their Own Labor
authlaborself.remarks: Indicates whether this group is authorized for its own labor code

nullrepfac.title: Allow Access to Records That Do Not Have a Repair Facility
nullrepfac.remarks: Specifies whether to allow the group access to records that do not specify a repair facility.

createdby.title: Created By
createdby.remarks: The user who created the record.

authlaborcrew.title: Authorize Group for Labor in Their Same Crew
authlaborcrew.remarks: Indicates whether this group is authorized for all labor in the same crew

maxschedreport.title: Scheduled Reports Limit
maxschedreport.remarks: The maximum number of reports that users in this security group can schedule.

authallsites.title: Group access to all sites
authallsites.remarks: Indicates whether this group has access to all sites in all organizations

sctemplateid.title: Start Center Template
sctemplateid.remarks: Unique identifier for Start Center Template

authlaborsuper.title: Authorize Group for Labor They Supervise
authlaborsuper.remarks: Indicates whether this group is authorized for all labor that this group supervises

workcenter.title: Work Center
workcenter.remarks: The default Work Center for a Group

sidenav.title: Display Side Navigation Menu
sidenav.remarks: Indicates whether the side navigation menu is displayed instead of the horizontal navigation toolbar.

changeby.title: Changed by
changeby.remarks: The user who updated the record.

authlaborall.title: Authorize Group for All Labor
authlaborall.remarks: Indicates whether this group is authorized for all labor

changedate.title: Change date
changedate.remarks: The date the record was last updated.

authallstorerooms.title: Authorize Group for All Storerooms
authallstorerooms.remarks: Indicates whether this group is authorized for all storerooms

passwordwarning.title: Days Before Password Expires to Warn User
passwordwarning.remarks: Number of days before expiration to warn the user that the password is about to expire. Defaults from the maxvar PASSWORDWARNING.

groupprofileid.title: Group profile id
groupprofileid.remarks: Group profile id for external identity provider.

dfltapp.title: Default Application
dfltapp.remarks: Specify the default application for users of the security group that will display when users log in and a user default application is not specified.

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

adhoccreatelimit.title: Ad Hoc Preview Records Limit
adhoccreatelimit.remarks: The maximum number of queried records that users can preview when they create an ad hoc report. This limit only applies to security groups that can create reports.

authpersongroup.title: Authorize Group for Labor in Their Same Person Group
authpersongroup.remarks: Indicates whether this security group is authorized for all labor in the same person group
